newsitem.title: USA: AutoImmune stake cut by Thomas Tisch group.
newsitem.headline: AutoImmune stake cut by Thomas Tisch group.

text.p: A group including investor Thomas Tisch on Monday said it reduced its stake in AutoImmune Inc to 1,034,700 shares, or 6.3 percent.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net 381,300 shares between March 19 and May 13 at prices ranging from $2.40 on May 13 to $6.00 on April 21.

AutoImmune shares have dropped in value since the Lexington, Mass., biopharmaceutical company earlier this year reported disappointing preliminary results of its Phase III trial of Myloral, a therapy for the treatment of multiple sclerosis.
In addition, in March the company said its fourth-quarter net loss widened to $6.7 million, or $0.41 a share, from a net loss of $3 million, or $0.19 a share, in the year-earlier period.
